renderedFields.description:
The Bug:

Several buttons and icons use the old tooltip design upon being hovered over.

Affected Buttons/Icons:

Here is a table of all of the affected buttons and icons that use the old tooltip design upon being hovered over. Please note that there could be more examples of this that aren't listed below.

Affected Buttons/Icons Location (GUI) Attachment
Statistics Sorting Buttons Statistics Menu statistics_sorting_buttons.png
Statistics Item Icons Statistics Menu statistics_item_icons.png
Realms Invitation Button Realms Menu realms_invitation_button.png
Realms Leave/Configure Realm Buttons Realms Menu realms_leave-configure_realm_buttons.png
Realms Traffic Icon Realms Menu realms_traffic_icon.png
Realms News/What is Realms? Buttons Realms Menu realms_news-what_is_realms_buttons.png
Realms World Backups "+" Changes Icon Realms Menu realms_world_backups_changes_icon.png
Realms World Icons Realms Menu realms_world_icons.png

Steps to Reproduce:

  1. Locate any of the buttons or icons listed above and hover over them.
  2. Take note as to whether or not several buttons and icons use the old tooltip design upon being hovered over.

Observed Behavior:

Several buttons and icons use the old tooltip design upon being hovered over.

Expected Behavior:

Several buttons and icons would use the new tooltip design upon being hovered over.
